mapper.select:
select pr.productid, pr.name, pr.price, pr.isactive, pr.codebid, cb.name as codebname, (ifnull(pi.total_in, 0) - ifnull(sa.total_out, 0) - ifnull(si.total_sales, 0)) as quantity from product pr left join codeb cb on pr.codebid = cb.codebid left join ( select productid, sum(quantity) as total_in from purchase group by productid ) pi on pr.productid = pi.productid left join ( select productid, sum(quantity) as total_out from stockadjustment group by productid ) sa on pr.productid = sa.productid left join ( select productid, sum(quantity) as total_sales from sales_item where status='ACTIVE' group by productid ) si on pr.productid = si.productid
order by
cb.name pr.name pr.price quantity pr.productid
desc asc
limit #{endRowNum} offset #{startRowNum}

select pr.productid, pr.name, pr.price, pr.isactive, pr.codebid, cb.name as codebname from product pr left join codeb cb on pr.codebid = cb.codebid
order by
cb.name pr.name pr.price pr.productid
desc asc
limit #{endRowNum} offset #{startRowNum}
mapper.insert: insert into product (codebid, name, price, isactive, createdat, profileimage, note) values(#{codeBId}, #{name}, #{price}, #{isActive}, #{createdAt}, #{profileImage, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{note, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: select pr.codebid, cb.name as codebname, pr.createdat, pr.isactive, pr.name, pr.updatedat, pr.profileimage, pr.note, pr.price from product pr left join codeb cb on pr.codebid = cb.codebid where productid=#{productId}
